content.short: Veda embeds yield across blockchains and protocols.
content.description: Veda delivers yield infrastructure by weaving yield opportunities across blockchains, protocols, and applications, providing users with one-click access to DeFi yield. It equips developers and builders with practical capabilities to efficiently capture and route the value generated by the DeFi ecosystem, enabling streamlined yield strategies and delivery to end users. The team pursues a vision of onboarding the next billion users into the digital asset world by making yield a native, familiar part of the user experience rather than a fragmented, multi‑protocol process.
